setup.title: Select a project and work session

skills.name: bootstrap
skills.when: Inspect or apply project setup once.

skills.name: review-setup
skills.when: Review or repair optional code review setup.

outputs: project handoff with root and shared settings
selected work-session id with original request and scoped checkpoint
checks: project root exists
session route is read-only
unfinished sessions require a human choice when the request is new or ambiguous
workflow commands keep the selected session id
related legacy workflow is surfaced and never silently replaced
recovery: preserve existing settings and evidence; report unreadable state
never attach a legacy project workflow to a new session automatically

discover.title: Investigate the named request

skills.name: knowledge-acquire
skills.when: Before analysis, find source-backed project notes related to the exact request.

skills.name: bmad-build
skills.when: Investigate the request and prepare the reviewed plan with BMad Build's clarify and plan steps.

checks: carry the exact request and selected project into the step
inspect the matching source or work item and cite file paths
separate observed facts, assumptions, and open questions
recovery: if a knowledge or tracker tool is unavailable, record that exact gap and continue only from project files actually inspected

ideate.title: Explore and shape an idea

skills.name: brainstorm-ideas
skills.when: Generate a broad set of options.

skills.name: forge-idea
skills.when: Pressure-test a chosen direction.

skills.name: research-decision
skills.when: Resolve a material unknown with evidence.

skills.name: product-brief
skills.when: Capture a promising direction as a brief.

skills.name: product-spec
skills.when: After a direction is chosen, record stable product behavior as a contract.

outputs: brief or product contract when requested
checks: keep ideas distinct from accepted requirements
record unresolved choices
recovery: save the current idea record and return to the last human choice

backlog.title: Prepare and validate work items

skills.name: generate-work-item
skills.when: Draft a work item from an accepted request.

skills.name: enrich-work-item
skills.when: Add missing detail and acceptance checks.

skills.name: decompose-backlog
skills.when: Split work that is too large or mixed.

skills.name: generate-breakdown-work-items
skills.when: Create linked child Tasks from an approved Story.

skills.name: validate-artifact
skills.when: Check the complete draft set before review.

checks: use tracker adapter rules
verify links and required fields before publication
recovery: keep drafts local when the tracker is unavailable

technical-plan.title: Prepare the technical approach

skills.name: architect
skills.when: Compare system designs and tradeoffs.

skills.name: sequence-verifiable-units
skills.when: Break delivery into independently testable blocks.

skills.name: validate-artifact
skills.when: Check that the plan covers scope and acceptance.

checks: state assumptions and affected areas
identify one focused live test per block
validate the complete plan before asking for review
recovery: revise only the affected plan section and invalidate dependent approvals

build.title: Implement one approved work item

skills.name: start-ticket
skills.when: Prepare the selected tracker item and checkout.

skills.name: write-spec
skills.when: Create or revise an approved item specification.

skills.name: implement-story
skills.when: Implement a ready Story in small steps.

skills.name: tdd
skills.when: Use a test-first loop for code changes.

skills.name: automated-tests
skills.when: Create or run relevant automated tests.

skills.name: check
skills.when: Run the project's prescribed checks.

checks: confirm approved plan, linked Tasks, and item-local specification
verify each meaningful block
recovery: preserve unfinished edits and checkpoint; do not mix another ticket into this run

verify.title: Verify and report the result

skills.name: prove-it-works
skills.when: Gather evidence that the change works.

skills.name: verify-this
skills.when: Check a specific claim or result.

skills.name: review
skills.when: Review the completed change for defects.

skills.name: finish-feature-development
skills.when: Close a completed feature workflow.

checks: report only checks that actually ran
separate local, installed, and live-host evidence
recovery: keep the item open and record the exact failed or unavailable check

suspend.title: Help the user suspend harness checks and continue ordinary work

skills.name: suspend-harness
skills.when: Ask the user to send `harness suspend` as its own message; never suspend for them.

checks: after the user sends `harness suspend`, verify with `harness suspension status`
confirm ordinary work can continue
recovery: report persistence failure; do not claim checks are suspended
